g.text: Mortality and VIS by hour-16 SCAI proxy stage

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: Mortality model sample: 156/900 deaths (17.3%). Stage bars include 882 stays alive and in the ICU at hour 16.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: VIS: boxes = IQR; line = median; whiskers = 5th–95th percentiles (outside values not plotted). Missing VIS is excluded; available / total shown.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #263542

g.text: Outside both panels: 15 deaths by hour 16; 3 earlier ICU departures/discharges (0 in-hospital deaths).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #263542

g.text: Stage A is unavailable. B–E are minimum evidenced proxy stages; unclassified does not mean normal.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: Standard six-drug VIS uses documented dose rates at hour 16. No recent documentation or an unresolvable dose makes VIS unavailable.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52606d

g.text: Descriptive comparison among stays alive/in ICU at hour 16. Vasoactive treatment contributes to SCAI staging, so these measures are not independent.
